name: pynnacle-nexus
summary: The pynnacle-nexus package was built as a companion for readers of "Python Odyssey: Into the Realm of Games" by Pinnacle Robotics, made to work hand in hand with the Pinnacle Nexus board featured throughout the book.
author: Rafael Red Angelo M. Hizon, Jenel M. Justo, Serena Mae C.S. Lee
